name: NGC 5585 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5585, a spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc5585-hubble
story: Hotspots of star formation dot the faint spiral arms of NGC 5585. Its stars, dust and gas make up only a small fraction of its mass, and it holds a far higher share of dark matter than similar galaxies.

claims.text: Hotspots of star formation along its faint spiral arms
Visible matter is only a small fraction of its mass
It contains a far higher proportion of dark matter than similar galaxies
